thedotmack/claude-mem.caption:
Comment “MEMORY” and I’ll DM you the link to this repo.

There’s a repo that takes notes on every Claude Code session you run and makes them searchable. Claude-Mem has over 95,000 GitHub stars.

Built-in memory only saves what Claude decides is worth keeping. Claude-Mem watches what Claude does, has
